issues.legal_issue: The special method for computing compensation for joint families applies to verified claims concerning agricultural property.
material_facts: The claimant had a verified claim concerning agricultural land left in West Pakistan.
The compensation authority found that the claimant and his brothers were members of a joint Hindu family and treated the agricultural land as joint property.
The authority calculated compensation using the agricultural-land scale and assessed the claimant’s share without first applying the special joint-family method.
The claimant challenged that calculation, and the court considered whether the special method applied to agricultural property.
issues.conclusion: The special joint-family compensation rule applies to the claim concerning agricultural land; the appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: The general words concerning a claim to property left by members of an undivided Hindu family include agricultural property. The governing compensation legislation does not distinguish between urban and agricultural verified claims in the relevant provisions, including sections 4 to 8 of the Displaced Persons (Compensation and Rehabilitation) Act, 1954. The Rules also contain provisions in Chapter IV that apply to agricultural claims, including rules 12 to 15. Rule 19 determines the unit for assessing compensation for a joint family, while rule 51 and rule 56 address the scale or conversion of compensation for agricultural claims. Chapter VIII governs how a determined unit is compensated and does not modify or override rule 19. No earlier cases are relied on.

predicates.verified_claim_compensation_proceeding: A person sought compensation on the basis of a claim that had been verified under the applicable claims process.
predicates.agricultural_property_claim: The compensation claim concerned agricultural property left by the claimant.
predicates.joint_family_property: The authority found that the property belonged to an undivided Hindu family of which the claimant was a member.

issues.definition: When a compensation proceeding concerns a verified claim to agricultural property found to belong to a joint family, the special joint-family compensation computation applies.
